plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.0 adds /superskillret:add to register custom skills (validated and stored in a separate user-pool that survives system index upgrades).
